additional_concerns: The formula consumes supplied classifications; it does not establish exposure measurement, LAF status or the existence and continuing effect of an SFC designation.

The source supplies no persistence or declassification rule. The assessment-time convention is acceptable only with the question's express exclusion of conclusions about historical classification or non-complex status.

The absence of a below-50% guard on the designation branch does not enlarge the known-Boolean classification result: at or above 50%, the mandatory branch already suffices. Adding that guard could unnecessarily prevent a known operative designation from resolving unknown exposure.
The indirect-exposure examples are expressly non-exhaustive and subject to SFC review. Any upstream implementation must avoid treating the listed instruments as a closed list.
The three supplied dependency IDs have no identifiable authority mapping or source hashes. No catalogue match or authority availability can be inferred.

Conflict blocking across the entire dependency closure is an additional runtime evidence policy, not a requirement stated by the circular. It can block an otherwise sufficient route; this is not itself an additional legal classification condition.
